scope: what CL_Connect actually needs before it can be invoked

calling_convention.0x5C060F: mov edi,ecx -- the argument arrives in ecx
calling_convention.0x5BEAE8: xor ecx,ecx -- the known caller passes 0
calling_convention.0x5C071E: the getchallenge send reads the netadr from [ebx+0x14]..[ebx+0x28], where ebx = cl

consequence: CL_Connect does not take the server address as an argument. It reads it out of cl (at cl+0x14 and beyond). Since cl is entirely zero, invoking CL_Connect now would send getchallenge to a zero address.
chicken_and_egg: the UI normally fills cl+0x14 with the selected server before calling CL_Connect; in our flow neither happens.
plan: first populate the address fields at cl+0x14 (type/ip/port for loopback:28970) -- this offset is far from the 0x109260 field that crashed
then invoke CL_Connect (0x5C05F0) on the window thread with a large stack
then check whether it writes clc.state and cl+0x100260 / cl+0x109260
